title: More flexible matrixInput
description:
Maybe this is already on the radar, but IMHO it would be more than a nice-to-have to have a more flexible `matrixInput` concerning
- **Column types**: It should be possible to have at least `logical` and `character` columns in addition to `numeric` and `integer`.
- **Removing rows**: Instead of removing the last row by clicking on the minus button the row with current focus should be removed.

title: matrixInput problem on recent update
description:
EDIT: 

Was either a problem with the development version of shiny or with some local corruption on my machine, because 

remove.packages("shiny")
devtools::install_github("shiny", "rstudio")

fixed this and other problems that started cropping up.

ORIGINAL MESSAGE BELOW:

https://gist.github.com/ptoche/8385584

On 12 January 2014 I noticed my app had broken. The same code on the server still works:

http://spark.rstudio.com/toche/demo-dynamic-matrix

Here is the message in the console:

Shiny URLs starting with /tableinput will mapped to /Users/PatrickToche/R/library/shinyIncubator/tableinput
Error in class(val) <- splitName[[2]] : 
invalid to set the class to matrix unless the dimension attribute is of length 2 (was 0)

Note: I don't know if this is the same issue reported by Sacha Epskamp. My app was working until very recently (December 2013). I upgraded to R 3.01 and R 3.02 as soon as they came out.

title: matrixInput stopped working in Shiny 0.6
description:
I noticed my app stopped working when upgrading both R and shiny lately. Here is a small example:

 shiny:::runGist("https://gist.github.com/SachaEpskamp/5791586")

For me this works on R 2.15.3 with shiny 0.5 but does not work on R 3.0.1 with shiny 0.6.
